title: Get the available regions for a Showcase via identity
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the countries or regions that a Showcase can target by specifying the identity that is bound to the Showcase, and has permission of the Showcase. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/showcase/region/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | identity_id {Required} | string | The ID of the identity that is bound to a Showcase and the identity needs to have permission of the Showcase. | | identity_type {Required} | string | Identity type.

Enum values:
  • `TT_USER`: TikTok User.
  • `BC_AUTH_TT`: TikTok Account User in Business Center.
See [Identities](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738958351620097) to learn more about different identity types. | | identity_authorized_bc_id {+Conditional} | string | Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.

ID of the Business Center that a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity is associated with.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/showcase/region/get/?identity_id={{identity_id}}&identity_type={{identity_type}}&advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| region_codes | string[] | The list of country or region codes that the Showcase (identity) can target.
For example, ["ID"]. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "region_codes": [ "ID" ] } } (/code) ```
